# `base64`

<!-- @generated by `cargo xtask docs-sql`; do not edit. -->

```text
base64(bin)
```

Converts the argument from a binary `bin` to a base 64 string.

| | |
|---|---|
| Krishiv | Implemented |
| Group | `string_funcs` |
| Kind | scalar (function) |
| Added in Spark | 1.5.0 |
| In Spark profiles | 3.5 and later |
| Arguments | 1 |
| Deterministic | yes |

## Examples

```sql
-- base64, example 1
> SELECT base64('Spark SQL');
U3BhcmsgU1FM
```

```sql
-- base64, example 2
> SELECT base64(x'537061726b2053514c');
U3BhcmsgU1FM
```
